name: Independent-v2 six-method comparison with ego speed control interval [0, 20] m/s
scope: Repeat the independent v2 matrix with seed 0 and 100 deterministic evaluation episodes per method-scenario job. The sole experimental-variable change from v2 is the ego longitudinal speed-control interval, raised from [0, 10] to [0, 20] m/s.

matrix.pairing: For each scenario, all six methods use training seed 0, the same ordered source-traffic partition, density multiplier, 100-episode evaluation seed block, reward, normalized action space, observation dimensions, source episode limit, and [0, 20] m/s longitudinal mapping.
matrix.aggregation: Report the single seed-0 result for every scenario and an equal-weight three-scenario macro average. Cross-training-seed standard deviation and significance are not estimable and must remain null/not claimed.

iteration_selection.eligibility: An iteration must have real closed-loop evidence on at least CARLA and Cross. Rank eligible variants by equal-weight observed target-scenario success, then collision, then target coverage.

selected.boundary: Historical promotion failed the Cross collision noninferiority gate; v2 will generate fresh matched evidence.
Historical evidence used a different budget and is used only for candidate screening.
Historical seed instability remains a known limitation; v2 itself has only one training seed.

carla.rationale: The reconstructed urban task has 840 motor vehicles/hour plus two pedestrian streams; 1.35x raises motor demand to 1134 vehicles/hour while retaining feasible insertion.

cross.rationale: The double-merge corridor receives 50% more social vehicles. Clones are offset 8-10 seconds so the unchanged ego can depart at 5 seconds before the added batch applies merge pressure.

roundabout.rationale: Roundabout-C is already the high-traffic source task with a large initial batch; 1.25x avoids reducing the study to entry gridlock.

environment_contract.traffic_implementation: Load frozen source traffic first, the speed20-v3-namespaced additive social-demand overlay second, and the unchanged source ego route last.
environment_contract.evaluation_partition_rule: Lexicographic source traffic index modulo five equals zero.
environment_contract.carla_partition_boundary: CARLA has one reconstructed traffic file, so source-file train/evaluation disjointness is impossible; episode RNG seeds remain paired.

smoke.evidence_scope: Engineering smoke only; never report as a method result.

comparison.evidence_scope: Single-training-seed speed-range comparison: 18 fresh 50k-step jobs and 1800 deterministic evaluation episodes. No cross-seed variance or significance claim.

artifact_contract.missing_value_rule: Missing or failed jobs remain explicit with null metrics; no value may be copied from independent v2, v1, or normal-density evidence.
artifact_contract.single_seed_uncertainty_rule: Population standard deviations remain null because one training seed cannot estimate cross-seed variability.
